content: The Founder slides his phone across to Research, the survey form open but the responses screen closed. 'The questions and how I sent it. You can see those, privately, this week. The answers stay with me until you tell me what they can and can't prove.' Then he turns to the board. 'Now item 3. Archive 002. My proposal, and it's only a proposal: keep the three-part format, an object, a tee and something living. What exactly, and the price, I'll decide in the next three weeks. I won't name it in this room just to fill a box.'
